local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local part = script.Parent
local clickDetector = part:WaitForChild("ClickDetector")
local clickSound = part:WaitForChild("Click")
local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

local originalPosition = part.Position
local originalTransparency = part.Transparency
local originalMeshScale = mesh and mesh.Scale or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

local isPopped = false

local function pop()
	if isPopped then return end
	isPopped = true
	part:SetAttribute("Popped", true)
	clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 0
	
	clickSound:Play()
	
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	if mesh then
		local targetScale = Vector3.new(originalMeshScale.X * 1.15, originalMeshScale.Y * 0.25, originalMeshScale.Z * 1.15)
		TweenService:Create(mesh, tweenInfo, { Scale = targetScale }):Play()
	end
	
	local partTween = TweenService:Create(part, tweenInfo, {
		Transparency = math.clamp(originalTransparency + 0.35, 0, 0.85),
		Position = originalPosition - Vector3.new(0, 0.08, 0)
	})
	partTween:Play()
	partTween.Completed:Wait()
	
	local current = script.Parent
	while current and current.Name ~= "working bubble wrap" and current.Parent do
		current = current.Parent
	end
	if current then
		local popEvent = current:FindFirstChild("BubblePoppedEvent")
		if popEvent and popEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			popEvent:Fire(part)
		end
	end
end

local function reset()
	isPopped = false
	part:SetAttribute("Popped", false)
	clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 32
	
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	if mesh then
		TweenService:Create(mesh, tweenInfo, { Scale = originalMeshScale }):Play()
	end
	TweenService:Create(part, tweenInfo, {
		Transparency = originalTransparency,
		Position = originalPosition
	}):Play()
end

clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(function()
	pop()
end)

part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ResetBubble"):Connect(function()
	if part:GetAttribute("ResetBubble") == true then
		reset()
		part:SetAttribute("ResetBubble", false)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local model = script.Parent
local bubbleWrapModel = model:WaitForChild("bubble wrap")

local popEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
popEvent.Name = "BubblePoppedEvent"
popEvent.Parent = model

local netFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
netFolder.Name = "BubbleBreakNetwork"
netFolder.Parent = model

local stateRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
stateRemote.Name = "StateUpdate"
stateRemote.Parent = netFolder

local resetRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
resetRemote.Name = "ResetRequest"
resetRemote.Parent = netFolder

local bubbleParts = {}
for _, child in ipairs(bubbleWrapModel:GetChildren()) do
	if child:IsA("BasePart") and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") then
		child.Anchored = true
		table.insert(bubbleParts, child)
	end
end

local totalBubbles = #bubbleParts
local poppedSet = {}
local poppedCount = 0

local function broadcastState()
	stateRemote:FireAllClients({
		poppedCount = poppedCount,
		totalCount = totalBubbles,
		isComplete = (poppedCount >= totalBubbles and totalBubbles > 0)
	})
end

popEvent.Event:Connect(function(part)
	if not poppedSet[part] then
		poppedSet[part] = true
		poppedCount = math.min(poppedCount + 1, totalBubbles)
		broadcastState()
	end
end)

local function resetSheet()
	poppedSet = {}
	poppedCount = 0
	for _, part in ipairs(bubbleParts) do
		part:SetAttribute("ResetBubble", true)
	end
	broadcastState()
end

resetRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	resetSheet()
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.wait(0.5)
	stateRemote:FireClient(player, {
		poppedCount = poppedCount,
		totalCount = totalBubbles,
		isComplete = (poppedCount >= totalBubbles and totalBubbles > 0)
	})
end)

	end
